test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/371980392801884a5db2f693fdc01b683685d2a390343d2bc4ef9ffb93f360f4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9fb2011e4fb95422732feb0e20134a584368a0469f1ef947e2186417395203.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c8bec3b672503d9c8fe65b5cdff67f98e3a9fe2bc82b1157b61a7db2bd0d66f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93b169db540d4850d6f3c9dfa34aa08e96594e1ddf9d4d557ee2d56ea09ea236.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'TPLR’.

Hence, “**TPLR**” is the odd one.
